title: Suite Talk podcast: two scares, one new outlook - rethinking health, work and what matters
summary: In this Movember episode of Suite Talk, Marex's Gary Pettit shares his experience of prostate cancer, heart health and balancing work with personal wellbeing.
body_markdown:
*Content note: this episode discusses cancer and serious illness*


The latest episode of Suite Talk marks Movember with an honest conversation about health, work and perspective.


How do you balance a career in global markets with running a sports agency? And how does your perspective change when you face not one, but two, serious health scares?


Gary Pettit, Global Head of Rates Products at Marex, joins host Mark Palmer to talk about his experience of prostate cancer and, separately, a serious heart condition, and how both have shaped the way he lives and works.


Gary’s message is simple: go and get checked. He talks about why people put it off, how he responded to a diagnosis that changed his outlook and why he is keen to share his experience with others.


Gary also discusses how he balances two demanding roles, and how that has influenced the way he thinks about teams, integrity and asking for help. Along the way, he shares the lessons he has learned and the advice he would give his 25-year-old self.
